programme.title: THE WITCH 2: THE OTHER ONE [English Dub]
programme.desc: After escaping from a secluded laboratory, a young girl with overwhelming power finds herself on the run from several mysterious organizations, seeking refuge with a woman and her younger brother.

programme.title: CRAZY SAMURAI: 400 VS 1 [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: The most famous battle of the swordsman Miyamoto Musashi. Miyamoto fights against 588 enemies, one after the other. There is no room for error, no room for trivial, outdated, or unconvincing movements.

programme.title: Sea Fog [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Written and produced by Bong Joon-ho (PARASITE, SNOWPIERCER, THE HOST), SEA FOG is a maritime thriller that captures the essence of why he is considered on of the most talented filmmakers working today. Upon learning that his decaying fishing trawler, the Junjin, is about to be sold, Captain Kang looks to make one final score by smuggling illegal immigrants from China to South Korea. After arriving at the agreed pickup point, a violent storm forces the Junjin to stall in open waters. As tension and unrest spread, Kang and his five-man crew find themselves pitted against their desperate passengers – all while an ominous fog envelops the ship and everyone onboard.

programme.title: The Isle [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: There is a fishing resort remote from the world. The owner, Hee-jin, drops by floating houses and serves the customers: by selling them food, necessities, and sex. One day, a new customer arrives: Hyun-suk is a former detective who killed his cheating girlfriend. Hee-jin feels a bond with him and keeps watching him. That night, he tries to shoot himself, but she stops him. As some incidents happen, she develops an obsession with him. And he also finds it difficult to leave the fishing resort and her.

programme.title: The Informant [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Detective O Nam-hyeok, a spectacularly inept cop clinging to his badge by a thread. When a botched sting operation lands him in hot water, he's forced to partner with Cho Tae-bong, a razor-sharp informant whose cover and savings are blown by Nam-hyeok's bumbling. With a smuggling ring to bust and zero trust between them, this mismatched duo must navigate double-crosses, bruised egos, and their own chaotic partnership while taking down a criminal organization.

programme.title: Chongqing Hot Pot [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Three money-strapped friends accidentally dig themselves into a bank vault ripe for robbing in this visually stunning crime-comedy.

programme.title: High Forces [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Distanced from his family after a car accident takes the sight of his daughter, a father must use his professional bodyguard training when a flight they're on is overtaken by armed hijackers. A taut puzzle of deception unravels when the hijackers' motivations are revealed and the father must rescue not only his daughter and wife, but all those aboard.

programme.title: My Daughter is a Zombie [English Dub]
programme.desc: Lee Jeong-hwan, a fierce animal trainer, lives a chaotic daily life with his rebellious teenage daughter, Lee Su-a who is full of passion for dancing. One day, Su-a becomes infected by a zombie virus that has swept across the globe. In a desperate bid to protect her, Jeong-hwan takes Su-a to Eunbong-ri, a seaside village where his mother, Kim Bam-sun, lives. Amid growing societal pressure to root out the infected, Jeong-hwan notices that Su-a, despite being a zombie, vaguely understands human speech and reacts to her favorite things: dancing and her grandmother’s sharp but loving flicks of the hand. Refusing to give up on her, Jeong-hwan draws on his years of experience as a tiger trainer and begins an intensive training program for his zombie daughter. A training journey more terrifying than handling a tiger and more difficult than dealing with teenage angst begins. The most heartwarming and hilarious top-secret project is about to unfold!

programme.title: Ghost Blows The Lamp of the Longling Temple [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Shirley Yang returns to China in search of professor Sun to rid herself of her erythema, only to find him trapped in the mysterious Long Ling cave.

programme.title: SPECIAL ID [English Dub]
programme.desc: A cop goes undercover in a ruthless underworld organization to stop a gang leader, only to put himself in great danger after being exposed by his former protégé and best friend.

programme.title: Shadow [English Dub]
programme.desc: In a kingdom ruled by a young and unpredictable king, the military commander has a secret weapon: a shadow, a look-alike who can fool both his enemies and the King himself. Now he must use this weapon in an intricate plan that will lead his people to victory in a war that the King does not want.

programme.title: Assassination [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Rebels plan a hit on a Commander. To execute it, they break a jailed killer, evade a hitman, and uncover a traitor.

programme.title: GINTAMA [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: In an era where aliens have invaded and conquered feudal Tokyo, a young samurai seeks work as he can.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: In his relentless search to find out what truly happened to his biological father, Logan uncovers something he didn’t bargain for – an assassin android that marches right up to the Alliance’s front door looking for its preprogrammed target – Nick Logan!

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: When a team of allied intelligence agents learns that extraterrestrial beings have been living among humans for years, they vow to protect earth.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Ruck, the werewolves pack leader, escapes from the Alliance and tracks down the EMP bomb which the Yeti race has been hiding. The doomsday device is accidentally activated while it’s being stolen, and Logan must discover its location before time runs out.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: An alien satellite that has been “watching” us for fifty years collides with a NASA shuttle. Rinaker doesn’t want its secrets exposed, so he sends Logan, Blaze, Trueblood and Ti-Yet on a stolen Lycanthrope ship to retrieve the data before anyone else. Logan hopes the information might reveal information about his father.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Cattle mutilation draws Logan to a small town and saddles him with a new partner, Dr. Petrovic. They discover science has spawned more trouble – hybrid, mutant, alien fire ants. Now they must rescue the townsfolk and the Detail Team before Rinaker calls an air strike on the town.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Mab, Queen of the Banshees, dispatches two bullheaded Minotauri bounty hunters and a cerberus parahound after the same prize – the head of Sh’lainn Blaze.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: A vampire that once worked for INTRAcom has mutated and is now staging attacks on his former boss’s holdings in an effort to protect the Brazilian rain forest. The creature rescues Logan, but Rinaker calls for an air strike on a lost Vampire city rather than risk its discovery by INTRAcom.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Sh’lainn’s death vision predicts everyone at the Alliance base will die in twelve hours. What she doesn’t realize is that she will be the cause. After coming into contact with a recovered alien probe, she reverts to her wildest Banshee state and begins mutating the technology around her. Magical “earth stones” from the Banshee clan may be her only hope.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Logan and Fitz are missing and presumed dead while on a mission to locate a downed alien ship in Haiti. They have been captured by a race of slug-like beings that can only inhabit the bodies of dead humans, which transforms them into zombies. Logan and Fitz are next and time is running out.

programme.title: Dork Hunters and The Pirates of Tortuga Island
programme.desc: The Dork Hunters visit tropical Tortuga Island on their summer vacation, unaware that the Dork Commander and his second-in-command are at the same resort in search of a buried treasure chest full of micro-galaxies

programme.title: Highlander: The Animated Series
programme.desc: A flashback shows the death of Connor MacLeod at Kortan's hand during the Jettator ceremony.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: When an Alliance raid on a Banshee clan permits the escape of Banshee renegade, Sh’lainn Blaze, the Alliance turns to professional bounty hunter Nick Logan for help. Logan’s investigation turns up questions about his own past life – even as the vengeful Banshee try to eliminate both Logan and his quarry.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Rinaker wants Nick and Sh’lainn eliminated because he’s afraid they know too much about the Alliance. The renegade bounty hunter and Banshee track an Alliance airship to its secret Roswell base. Logan is ready to turn himself in to get some answers, but the Banshee grab Sh’lainn and Logan must turn to the Alliance for help with her rescue.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: On their first Alliance assignment, Nick and Sh’lainn are sent by Rinaker to the Himalayas to find a missing team of mountain climbers. They find the alien refugees – the Yeti – who are guarding a stolen Lycanthrope weapon powerful enough to destroy the planet. All are in danger, as the werewolves will stop at nothing to get the weapon back in their possession.

programme.title: Hope Is Here
programme.desc: HOPE IS HERE features inspiring and uplifting, relevant and refreshing, personal stories told by cancer survivors, their families, and the loved ones of those who lost the fight against this “emperor of all maladies” and sparked a movement that gives added meaning to their lives. Their moving stories show how the light of hope is salvaged from depths of despair.

programme.title: Hope Is Here
programme.desc: Lung cancer diagnoses for young, non-smoking individuals are a growing trend. But that didn't intimidate the athletic and courageous lung cancer patient, 21-year-old Jill Costello. Jill's fighting spirit and her desire to help find a cure and eradicate the stigma that only smokers contracted the disease would eventually define her legacy.

programme.title: Hope Is Here
programme.desc: Hank Baskett was given the grim diagnosis of stage 4 lung cancer almost ten years ago. At the time his thoughts were not of himself but of how he was going to tell his family. In episode 3 of Hope is Here we meet Hank and his family and learn how he was able to push forward towards health with a hopeful attitude and mission that his cancer journey would be, in his words, a joyful one.

programme.title: Hope Is Here
programme.desc: Gina Hollenbeck is positive about life. Every day she lives with an optimistic desire to overcome and thrive despite a stage 4 lung cancer diagnosis. As a young mother of two boys, she forges ahead towards a vibrant and meaningful journey with a mission to help find a cure for not only herself but for others who suffer from this deadly disease.

programme.title: Hope Is Here
programme.desc: Emily Bennett Taylor and her husband Miles were newlyweds with a bright future planned. Just as they were house hunting and talking about raising a family Emily received the news that she had stage 4 lung cancer. She and her husband recall their cancer journey and recount their determination to live life to its fullest while fighting for the chance to have children despite a grave cancer diagnosis.

programme.title: Hope Is Here
programme.desc: Life can be full of hope and dreams. Lisa Briggs was enjoying a successful business, and a close-knit family while celebrating the arrival of her second child. Yet within months of giving birth Lisa was told the devastating news; she had stage 4 lung cancer. For an athletic, young woman who never smoked, the diagnosis seemed unreal. After the shock wore off, Lisa went into full action ahead as her will to live proved stronger than her devastating cancer.

programme.desc: The team, led by Anand, prepare for their motorcycle adventure to the four sacred peaks. The first practice ride is here in the birthplace of yoga, but it is not encouraging as monsoons are destroying roads and villages, Fred seems a liability and Ryan's seizures could be an issue.

programme.title: Road To Dharma
programme.desc: Jen and Jeff’s dream is to save their marriage on this journey, but it’s clear they are in different mindsets from the beginning. We are reminded that Anand himself had a prophecy of death and his teachers and life adventures helped guide him to freedom. Heading towards Kedarnath, night’s darkness sets in and Ryan sees someone Flip over their handlebars…

programme.title: Road To Dharma
programme.desc: Our first glimpse of the first peak, Kedarnath, the temple of death. Anand reminds us that What needs to die is part of the ego, fears, and comforts. Ken thinks people are riding recklessly, Mario takes his first spill, injuring his passenger Aizhan. Jeff ‘s comments further alienate Jen, but motivate her to rise up to greatness…

programme.title: Road To Dharma
programme.desc: Emptiness and Power in the Gap. The stunning Tungnath Peak at 13,000 ft, the Feminine Temple above the Masculine. programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Leonardo le cuenta a Carlos Ernesto que Alejandra Altamirano le confirmó que Rebeca, su esposa, está viva. Irene le confirma a su amiga, Maribel, que está embarazada y que se lo va decir a Leonardo por la noche junto a sus hijos pero ella le dice que su esposo se irá de viaje. Virginia le dice a María Lucía que es su mamá, y le cuenta las razones por las que no pudo hacerse cargo de ella. Aunque se niega a contarle la verdad de cómo fue concebida como así tampoco debe enterarse el padre de la existencia de ella. Maribel le exige a Juan Pablo que deje de acosarla. Ella prefiere perder su trabajo en la empresa antes que tener que hacer otras cosas que no le competen en su puesto. Leonardo viaja hasta la clínica y el doctor le presenta a su paciente.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Leonardo se reencuentra con Rebeca después de cinco años de separación. Ambos se encuentran muy conmocionados. El doctor le explica que cuando encontraron a Rebeca la pusieron bajo tratamiento, y que sus presupuestos no alcanzaban para averiguar sobre sus antecedentes, y un día le dieron medicación del laboratorio Ferrándiz, y ella recuperó absolutamente toda la memoria, y pudieron localizarlo. Leonardo decide ir a un hotel a pasar la noche y pensar cómo hará para decirle a sus hijos y a Irene sobre la aparición de Rebeca. Leonardo ignora que todo eso es un engaño departe de Alejandra y Adolfo, y que el mismo doctor también sabe eso. La nueva Rebeca volverá a la casa Ferrándiz y conseguirá ser dueña de la fortuna de la familia, dejando además a un lado a Irene.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Celia busca a su hijo mientras rechaza la herencia de Néstor. Néstor se acerca a Moisés, quien se aleja de Elizabeth por miedo. Katiuska planea aprovecharse de la infertilidad de Manuela y la acosa con llamadas anónimas. Ricardo y Elizabeth intentan mantener la paz, pero Celia se enfrenta a su hija por defender a su padre. Mientras Manuela sale de la clínica, la tensión familiar crece y Misael protege la parroquia de un robo, dejando el futuro de todos en incertidumbre.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Ricardo confronta a Celia por las llamadas y ella finge arrepentimiento. Gustavo se recupera bajo cuidado médico, mientras Katiuska obtiene el diario de Misael. Néstor revela a Margot que Ricardo tiene otra familia de 15 años, lo que desata su furia. María es despedida inesperadamente tras creer que sería ascendida. Celia planea comprometer a Ricardo con una carta antigua y Jade la ayuda a buscar una enfermera para Manuela tras saber que es estéril. Marcelo recibe su demanda de divorcio.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Misael le revela a Manuela que Glorita es su hija, mientras Katiuska introduce a Jade disfrazada de enfermera en casa de Ricardo. Margot confronta a Hortensia y luego a Celia por su relación con Ricardo, a lo que Celia culpa a Manuela de destruir su hogar. Por otro lado, Brigitte planea recuperar a su hijo a toda costa, y la tensión aumenta cuando Ricardo rechaza la renuncia de Verónica y advierte sobre las intenciones de Katiuska.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Marcelo aconseja a Ricardo terminar con Celia por Manuela, quien busca ayuda médica para concebir. Jade y Katiuska conspiran contra Manuela escondiendo una carta y enviando llamadas anónimas que le causan crisis nerviosas. Brigitte se une al plan de Katy a cambio de dinero. Mientras Hortensia descubre la infidelidad de Ricardo, él intenta recuperar la confianza de Manuela. Por otro lado, Misael enfrenta dificultades legales contra los Tariffi y Celia estalla en furia por celos.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Celia busca retener a Ricardo quitándose su dispositivo anticonceptivo para quedar embarazada. Mientras tanto, Katiuska engaña a Manuela con facturas falsas de compras femeninas, haciéndola creer que Ricardo le miente. Por otro lado, Néstor revela que Elizabeth y Moisés son hermanos antes de que se enamoren. Misael planea un asalto a la empresa Tariffi para costear su defensa legal. Finalmente, Manuela confronta a Ricardo y decide abandonar la casa, sintiéndose traicionada.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Rosa miente a Alejandro ocultando que Erasto asesinó a su hermano Carlos. El informe de bomberos confirma que el incendio fue provocado. Rosalía ofrece sociedad capitalista a Consuelo y Leticia para reconstruir la boutique. Erasto se encuentra con Rosa en casa de Consuelo en su segundo enfrentamiento, amenazando con descubrirla como ladrona. Maricela se interna prometiendo desintoxicarse pero deja a Junior vigilando a su padre creéndolo amante de Consuelo. Rosa enfrenta a Alejandro al saber su noviazgo con Rosalía; ella los interrumpe a ambos.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Rosalía lanza a Rosa que se casará con Alejandro, humillándola. Isaías amenaza a Consuelo con dejarla si se asocia con los Alamo. Erasto reprocha a Eustoquio no haber matado a Blanca. Junior entra al cuarto de Rosa, cierra con llave e intenta abusar de ella; Rosa se defiende clavándole un cuchillo y Carmen la obliga a llevarlo al hospital. René y Mariela encuentran a Blanca hospitalizada. Eustoquio y Humberto envuelven a Isaías en la venta de dólares ilegales. Rosalía planea venganza junto a su padre.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Isaías acepta unirse a Eustoquio y Humberto en la venta de dólares a comerciantes. Arminda invoca ánimas para contrarrestar el hechizo que Natalia tiene sobre Erasto. Consuelo acepta a Rosalía como socia ignorando que es hija de Adolfo. Junior se mete en el cuarto de Rosa cerrando con llave e intenta forzarla; ella lo apuñala defendiéndose y Carmen la manda a llevarlo al hospital. Rosalía visita a Alejandro acompañada de Amalia. Adolfo cena con Consuelo, quien lo confronta directamente preguntando por su esposa y su verdadero lugar.

programme.desc: Sol encara a Alejandro en presencia de Aída y le anuncia que se va con su niña. Le reprocha por negarla y por mandar manipular la historia clínica. Luego Alicia le comenta a Reina que no podrá seguir ocultándole la verdad, a menos que Maricielo muera.

programme.desc: En el centro comercial | Yubiri se encuentra nuevamente con Wilker mostrándose afín a su tristeza tras saberlo en serios conflictos con Lolita | Wilker aprovecha la ocasión de estar acompañado por Yubiri para reiterarle a esta su interés por ella pese a su negativa de aceptar sus propios sentimientos. Tras revelarle su intención de matrimonio con Mauricio Ana se ve en la necesidad de aclarar su situación con Olegario al intentar convencerlo para que este acepte quedarse en su casa.

programme.desc: Rómulo está muy desesperado por ver a Egleé y así le diga lo que pasa con Gerson estando en su casa y ella intenta explicarle la situación. Después, en la construcción, la policía va a investigar lo que sucedió y Paco se molesta por el mal plan de Bracho.

Mientras que los problemas retrasan a Leonardo cada vez más, Irene empieza a confundirse y a divagar sobre el porqué del viaje inesperado de su esposo, angustiándose por no poder contarle que está esperando un hijo. Le pide ayuda a Maribel para que revisen los planes de vuelo del jet. María Lucía se encuentra en la oficina de Carlos Ernesto con Leo, discutiendo sobre su relación supuestamente no correspondida.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Carmen le muestra una foto a Sol, capturada en el aeropuerto, donde se ve a Cristina, la hija que Reina abandonó a los dos años, entrando al país. Más tarde, Heriberto se le presenta a Sol semidesnudo y borracho, pretendiendo hacerle el amor a la fuerza. Sol logra convencerlo de que se reponga y haga las cosas bien, y le prepara un café. Sin embargo, Heriberto toma un somnífero y lo coloca en el café de Sol, aunque se equivoca y se toma el café él. Momentos luego comienza a marearse.

Hoy narra su testimonio en el libro 'El ave negra', exponiendo décadas de encubrimiento eclesiástico.

programme.title: Los Informantes

programme.title: Serafima la bella
programme.desc: Esta es la historia de amor de una mujer fuerte; Serafima, quien está en un triángulo amoroso. Durante veinte años, su rival y ella han amado al mismo hombre. Además de melodrama, también muestra la vida cotidiana. Un relato sobre la historia de Rusia a través de los ojos de una persona. El destino de Serafima refleja la historia de todo el país: desde la época soviética, la perestroika, hasta la época actual.

programme.title: Serafima la bella
programme.desc: Sima queda embarazada de Víctor. Tras una pelea, él es herido y ella lo cuida. Irina, la chica que Víctor ama, descubre la verdad y lo deja. Víctor y Sima se casan, pero él solo espera el nacimiento del bebé.

programme.title: Serafima la bella
programme.desc: El hijo de Sima nace con una grave enfermedad del corazón. Víctor la culpa. Sima busca ayuda médica en Moscú y conoce a una periodista que duda que un cirujano famoso la opere.

programme.title: Serafima la bella
programme.desc: Irina y Víctor retoman su romance. Sima acude al cirujano Krasin por su hijo y termina salvándolo de un atentado. Agradecido, Krasin acepta operar al niño.

programme.title: Serafima la bella
programme.desc: Sima permite que Irina y Víctor se vean los fines de semana. Empieza a construir su casa, mientras Irina se involucra con un gánster. Un grupo de delincuentes incendia los establos de Sima.

programme.title: Serafima la bella
programme.desc: Sima pierde a su bebé y queda estéril. Irina queda embarazada de otro hombre pero miente diciendo que es de Víctor. Sima le propone divorcio a Víctor y cae en una profunda depresión.

programme.title: Serafima la bella
programme.desc: Sima convence a Irina de darle el bebé a cambio de dinero. Irina se marcha, mientras Víctor planea estudiar veterinaria. Irina, en caída libre, recurre a la brujería para vengarse de Víctor, quien es diagnosticado con leucemia.

programme.title: Serafima la bella
programme.desc: Sima vende sus caballos para pagar la cirugía de Víctor en Alemania. Un adicto roba el dinero y lo entrega a un traficante. Víctor huye del hospital en busca del ladrón.
